description:

College Board - Global Policy & External Relations
Location: This is a fully remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.
Type: This is a full-time position

About the Team  
The Global Policy & External Relations Policy and Advocacy team shapes the policy, partnership, and external conditions that allow College Board programs to reach more students and retain public trust. The team sits at the intersection of program strategy, state policy, government relations, higher education, state and district partnerships, engagement, research, and external influence.

The State Policy and Strategy function is a new state growth strategy vertical within Policy and Advocacy. It is designed to move College Board from reactive state work to a disciplined, proactive model that names the few state moves that matter most, aligns leaders on tradeoffs, and turns enterprise priorities into sequenced state plans.
 
About the Opportunity   
States are making consequential decisions about course access, assessment, career-connected learning, credit recognition, teacher credentialing, and the future meaning of college and career readiness. These decisions shape whether AP, SAT Suite, BigFuture, and career-connected initiatives can reach students at scale - and how College Board grows its programs in an increasingly complex state policy environment.

The Senior Director, State Policy and Strategy - Western Region will own a portfolio of state strategies that translates College Board ’s policy priorities into sequenced, actionable state plans. This means building the fact base for Western Region states, identifying where state conditions create opportunity or risk, making the case for where to invest and where to hold, and aligning internal partners around the plays that matter most.

This is a senior strategy role with real influence over where College Board places its bets at the state level. Success requires the ability to synthesize complex political and policy landscapes quickly, work fluently across multiple policy domains without needing to own any single one, and lead cross-functional teams toward clear decisions in an organization where expertise, relationships, and execution are distributed across many strong partners.
In this role, you will: 

Build and Own Regional State Strategy
Develop and maintain a current fact base for every Western Region state - including policy conditions, political and governance dynamics, coalition strength, program opportunities, implementation barriers, and risk. Translate that intelligence into concise state plans that show the complete picture: goals, current and pursued policies, external actors, internal owners, available levers, sequencing, and implementation needs.

Recommend priority states and plays to the Executive Director based on policy opportunity, student reach, adoption potential, feasibility, and College Board priorities. Connect regional strategy to AP, SAT Suite, BigFuture, and career-connected education priorities - including 0-to-1 AP growth, SAT School Day, AP Career Kickstart, and BigFuture opportunity pathways. Align regional planning to College Board planning cycles, legislative sessions, and sales cycles so state work moves from episodic response to deliberate sequencing.

As a Staff Full Stack Engineer (Backend Focus), you will build and operate the backend of a Web Analytics and AI portal. That includes the APIs that serve the application, the read data layer over analytical data, authentication and authorization, and the integration points with the services the rest of the team builds. The portal gives commercial intelligence to the people who make business decisions, through daily briefings, customizable KPIs, analytical insights, geographic exploration, and conversational analytics.
This is a Staff (L6), hands-on individual contributor role on a lean team where everyone is Staff: a Staff Architect, Staff AI Engineers, Staff Software Engineers, and Data Engineers. • Diagnose and fix reliability issues, and lead incident response and blameless postmortems.

• Establish safe rollout practices: feature flags, canary releases, and fast rollback.

Design and raise the bar

title: Payments Team Lead
description:
The Payments Team Lead owns the performance and service quality of Leadtech 's payment ecosystem across two complementary functions: a Revenue Optimization team , focused on maximizing authorization rates and transaction profitability across PSPs and payment methods, and an Account Management team , which acts as the internal payments partner to Leadtech 's business units, managing payment strategy on a B2B basis within the company.
This person must bring a very strong technical/analytical leadership (data-driven AR improvement, PSP economics, APM evaluation) together with internal stakeholder management (service quality, account ownership, cross-BU coordination), to successfully manage and develop the two direct sub-teams.
Key Responsibilities
1. Payment & Revenue Optimization

• Monitor and optimize payment performance and transaction profitability across PSPs and business units.

• Analyze Payment Authorization Rates (AR), decline reasons, traffic distribution and payment performance to identify opportunities for improvement.

• Support the implementation of payment optimization initiatives, including 3DS, network tokens, retry logic, routing rules and data enrichment.

• Evaluate new Alternative Payment Methods (APMs) and PSP optimization tools based on business impact, customer experience and ROI.

• Work with internal stakeholders and external PSPs to identify and resolve payment performance issues.

• Build and maintain dashboards and reporting to support day-to-day payment decision-making, including AR, decline reasons and PSP/MID performance.

2. Internal Account Management & Business Partnership

• Own and proactively manage the payment strategy for each business unit

• Act as a trusted payments partner for Leadtech 's business units, understanding their payment needs and supporting them in achieving their business goals.

• Provide recommendations on PSP and APM mix based on business requirements, traffic profiles and risk considerations.

• Proactively communicate payment performance, incidents, opportunities and relevant roadmap initiatives to internal stakeholders.

• Coordinate payment-related requirements for new business needs, including new MIDs, markets, PSPs and payment methods.

• Establish effective communication and escalation processes with business units and relevant internal teams.

3. Team Leadership

• Lead and support a Payments team across Revenue Optimization and Account Management activities.

• Set priorities and coordinate workload based on business impact, urgency and team capacity.

• Coach and develop team members, providing guidance, feedback and support to help them grow their capabilities.

• Help establish team objectives and contribute to the achievement of Payments & Risk OKRs.

• Act as a point of escalation between the team and other Payments & Risk functions, including Risk Analytics, Finance and Partnerships.

• Report on team performance, key challenges and progress to the Payments & Risk Manager.

4. Cross-Functional Coordination

• Partner with Risk & Compliance on payment-related risk and chargeback initiatives that may impact authorization rates and routing decisions.

• Collaborate with external payment orchestration partners and PSP account managers on routing, enrichment, APM and other payment-related initiatives.

• Work closely with Product, Engineering, Finance, Risk and business stakeholders to ensure payment initiatives are aligned with business priorities.

• Ensure payment optimization initiatives are evaluated from both a performance and business-unit perspective before implementation.

Success Metrics / KPIs

• Improvement in Payment Authorization Rate (AR), overall and by PSP/BU.

• Checkout conversion improvement.

• Revenue and performance impact from new APMs and PSP optimization initiatives.

• Payment performance and issue resolution times.

• Internal stakeholder satisfaction and adherence to agreed SLAs.

• Adoption and effective use of payment analytics

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer, AI Builder
description:
Insurance is one of the world's largest industries and one of the most painful to interact with . Paper forms. Sluggish call centres. Three-week underwriting cycles. Claims that vanish into queues. We are rebuilding all of it on top of a modern platform and AI agents that actually do the work, not pretend to.
You will not be picking up tickets. You will be deciding what to build, prototyping it on Monday, shipping a draft to a real customer by Friday, and improving it from real usage. We expect you to push the product, the codebase, and the way we work.
Why This Role Exists
We are looking for someone who treats AI as a creative material, not a feature on a roadmap. The next year of insurance is being defined right now. What gets automated, what gets reimagined, what gets thrown out. We want builders who want to be in that room and ship the answer.
The team is small. The mandate is large. If your highest-energy work has historically come from solving real problems end to end, this is the seat.
What You Will Do

•
Own outcomes, not tickets. Pick the biggest lever for our customers each sprint and drive it to live. Surface the next one yourself.

•
Build with AI as a primary tool, not a chatbot bolt-on. OCR, document understanding, generation, agent loops, evaluation harnesses. You decide where each fits.

•
Ship prototypes fast, then make them production-grade. A working demo on day three beats a perfect plan on day ten.

•
Work directly with customers. You will see real claims, real underwriting screens, real broker workflows. You will watch users hit dead ends and decide what to fix.

•
Raise the bar on the codebase. Reviews, refactors, testability, observability. Not as policy, as habit.

•
Push the team forward. Skills, agents, internal tools, engineering standards. Propose them, build them, get them adopted.

Who You Are

•
You ship. Ideas without execution do not count for you.

•
High agency. You do not wait for a card to be assigned. You see what is worth doing and you start.

•
Strong opinions, loosely held. You make calls with incomplete information and change your mind when the evidence shifts.

•
Curious about the domain. Insurance is messy and full of weird incentives. That intrigues you, not annoys you.

•
Fluent with AI. You have shipped something real with LLMs or agents. You know where the magic ends and where you have to engineer carefully.

•
Care about humans on the other end. Insurance done right gives people peace of mind in their worst weeks. That is the point.

Your Toolbox
We use Node.js + TypeScript + Nest.js on the back end, Vue (and some React) on the front end, GraphQL, MongoDB, Docker, AWS. AI work spans OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, plus a growing set of in-house skills and agents. You do not need to have used every piece. You do need to be the kind of engineer who picks up a new tool and is shipping with it within the week.
What We Expect at This Level

•
6+ years building production systems. Track record of complex, customer-facing software shipped, not just maintained.

•
Real AI experience. You have built and shipped at least one substantive AI-driven feature. POCs that died in a notebook do not count here.

•
Strong fundamentals. OO, design patterns, testing, web security, performance. You do not need a refresher.

•
Cloud comfort. AWS, Azure, or GCP. At least one in depth, the rest enough to hold a conversation.

•
Communication. You can explain a tradeoff to a non-technical stakeholder in two minutes and to an engineer in one.

Not Suitable for the Role If…

• You prefer tickets assigned to you over choosing what to build.

• You measure your work in lines of code, not outcomes.

• You see AI as a buzzword to put on your CV rather than a tool you have actually used in anger.

• You want a process-heavy environment with detailed specs handed down from product.

• You are looking for a maintenance role on a finished platform.

Why CoverGo

title: Pastoral Coach
description:
Be Part of Something Eternal
Nearly 2 billion Muslims have never heard the saving message of Jesus Christ . At Frontiers , we believe God is calling His Church to change that. We partner with local churches to send workers to the Muslim world-workers who make disciples and plant churches where the Gospel has never been heard.
If you’re passionate about mobilizing the Church for global mission and equipping leaders to fulfill the Great Commission, this role is for you.
Coaching. Support. Shepherd.
As a Pastoral Coach, you’ll come alongside field workers serving around the world, providing spiritual encouragement, prayer, coaching, and relational support so they can thrive in their walk with Jesus and remain effective in their ministry. If you have a heart for missions, a passion for caring for others, and a desire to invest in the wellbeing of cross-cultural workers, this is an opportunity to make a lasting Kingdom impact.
At Frontiers , we believe God is calling His Church to bring the Gospel to the least-reached Muslim peoples. Our field workers serve in some of the most challenging and spiritually significant places on earth. Through intentional relationships, pastoral care, and Christ-centered coaching, the Barnabas Team helps sustain and strengthen those on the front lines of ministry. As a Pastoral Coach, you will play a vital role in encouraging, equipping, and caring for workers as they faithfully pursue God's calling among the nations.
About the Role
As a Pastoral Coach , you will:

• Seek to develop and maintain active relationships with field workers and their teams.

• Read newsletters and email updates from selected Frontiers field workers to keep track of their status and general wellbeing.

• Seek to debrief field workers upon their home assignment and follow up as necessary.

• When workers return from the field in transition or in another type of extended field leave, provide pastoral leadership and accountability as needed.

• Establish a rhythm of prayer and spiritual support encouraging field workers to thrive in their relationship with Jesus.

• Initiate relationships with workers at every opportunity. Seek to be available for encouragement, coaching, counseling and prayer.

• Raise 100% of your financial support (salary, benefits, ministry expenses)

What We’re Looking For

• A personal relationship with Jesus Christ and a heart for missions

• Previous missions experience either 2-3 years living overseas or extensive interaction with field workers.

• Heart for missions, cross cultural workers, Muslims and pastoring others.

• Ability to travel 2-3 times per year and willing to raise funds as needed for coaching trips and IC.

• Pastoral or Life Coaching experience preferred.

• A track record of being sought by people for pastoring, especially by field workers.

• Ability to travel occasionally and raise personal support

• Spiritual gifts in leadership, encouragement, and teaching

• Ability to raise and maintain personal support

Why Join Frontiers ?
When you join Frontiers , you become part of a grace-filled, mission-driven community that:

•
Prioritizes the least-reached - We focus on Muslim peoples with no sustainable Gospel witness.

•
Catalyzes movements - Everything we do contributes to planting healthy, reproducing churches.

•
Empowers teams - Our teams serve with a common vision and freedom to pursue locally appropriate strategies.

•
Values lifelong learning - We are dedicated to coaching, mentoring, and continuous growth.

•
Operates with integrity - Decisions are made by those closest to the action, ensuring effectiveness and accountability.

•
Work - Life culture - We encourage healthy rhythms, flexibility, and margin so team members can sustainably pursue their calling, invest deeply in relationships, and serve with excellence-both in the work and in the mission beyond it.

title: Bot Support Specialist - Global, Remote
description:
About TJM Labs

TJM Labs is building the digital workforce for pharmacy.
Pharmacies are being asked to do more with fewer resources. Prescription volumes are growing, margins are tightening, and talented pharmacy teams spend too much of their day on repetitive operational work.
We're changing that.
TJM Labs builds AI-powered automation designed specifically for pharmacy. Our technology works within the systems pharmacies already use to automate repetitive workflows and create more capacity for pharmacists and pharmacy technicians to focus on the work that actually requires them.
As our customer base grows, we need people who can help pharmacies get answers quickly, understand when something isn't working as expected, and connect what the customer is experiencing with the technical teams who can solve it.
About the Role
We're looking for a Pharmacy Bot Support Specialist to provide responsive, thoughtful day-to-day support to pharmacies using TJM automation.
You'll work as part of a customer pod alongside Customer Success Managers, Implementation Leads, and technical teams.
This is not an account ownership role. You won't own the customer relationship, customer strategy, or implementation project.
Instead, you'll be one of the first people our pharmacy customers turn to when they have a question, need help, or tell us, 'The bot isn't doing what we expected.' Your job is to figure out what that actually means.
Sometimes the answer will be straightforward. Other times, you'll need to ask questions, understand the pharmacy workflow, gather examples, look at system information, reproduce the behavior, and document what you've learned so our technical teams can investigate efficiently.
You don't need to be an engineer. You do need to be technically curious, comfortable troubleshooting, an excellent communicator, and willing to keep asking questions until you understand what's actually happening.
What You'll Do
1. Be a Responsive First Point of Support
You'll help manage incoming day-to-day communication from pharmacy customers across our support channels.

• Respond promptly and professionally to customer questions and reported issues.

• Ask thoughtful follow-up questions to understand exactly what the customer is experiencing.

• Gather the information needed to determine whether something is a question, training issue, workflow issue, configuration issue, product issue, or potential defect.

• Help customers resolve issues that can be addressed without engineering involvement.

• Set clear expectations about what happens next when additional investigation is required.

• Keep customers updated rather than leaving them wondering whether anyone is working on their issue.

• Close the loop once an issue has been resolved.

You won't be expected to have every answer. You will be expected to take responsibility for getting the information to the right person and making sure the question doesn't disappear.
2. Investigate Before You Escalate
One of the most important parts of this role is turning a customer-reported problem into something our technical teams can efficiently investigate.

• Ask targeted questions about what happened before, during, and after the reported issue.

• Gather specific examples, timestamps, prescription or workflow context, screenshots, and other appropriate information.

• Understand what the customer expected to happen versus what actually happened.

• Review available system activity, configurations, logs, and other troubleshooting information.

• Attempt to reproduce reported behavior when appropriate.

• Determine whether the issue affects one scenario or a broader workflow.

• Check known issues and available documentation before escalating.

• Document what you've already investigated so another team doesn't have to start from zero.

Your goal is to make sure engineering spends its time solving technical problems rather than trying to figure out what the problem is.
3. Create Excellent Technical Support

title: Founders Associate (IT & Automation)
description:
YOUR ROLE AT LIO

At Lio, we’re building a fast-growing AI company and we want our internal operations to reflect the technology we build.

As a Founder’s Associate Intern/ Working Student focused on IT & Automation, you’ll own our day-to-day IT operations and build the systems that help us scale. You’ll make sure people have the tools, access, and support they need, then look for ways to make those processes simpler, more reliable and increasingly automated.

One day, you might be setting up laptops, onboarding a new colleague, or troubleshooting our office network. The next, you could be connecting systems through APIs, building an internal tool or creating an AI agent that saves the team hours of manual work.

Make it work. Make it better. Then automate it.

You’ll work closely with our CTO, own projects from problem to implementation and see the impact of your work across the company.

- Turn repetitive work into automated workflows. Find manual tasks across IT and business operations, identify where automation adds value, and build solutions that save time and reduce errors.

- Build practical internal tools. Use AI-assisted coding, Python, APIs, and low-code platforms to solve real operational problems.

- Connect our systems. Integrate Microsoft 365, Slack, and other SaaS platforms so information flows smoothly and teams spend less time switching between tools.

- Put AI to work. Test AI agents and emerging automation tools, turning useful experiments into reliable solutions the team can use.

- Drive improvements with the founders. Identify bottlenecks, propose a better approach, and take ownership of delivering it from the first idea through rollout and ongoing improvement.

WHY JOIN LIO?

Lio is backed by Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) and built at Y Combinator. We're bringing Silicon Valley ambition and engineering culture to Munich.

From day one, you'll work with Fortune 500 companies across Europe and the US, solving real-world technical challenges at the intersection of AI and enterprise software.

We move fast, care deeply about execution, and give engineers ownership from day one. The solutions you build won't stay customer-specific and they'll shape the future of our platform.

If you're excited about building with us, we'd love to hear from you.

title: AI Optimisation Engineer
description:
About Us
Polus is pioneering the Public Safety marketplace. Our products are used by Search & Rescue, first responders, and disaster relief teams globally. We are developing radio equipment that is compatible with cellular technologies. Our goal is simple. We aim to reinvent the way Public Safety is perceived and approached. We are tireless in our pursuit of connecting communities and ensuring a safer tomorrow, today.
As our AI Optimisation Engineer, you will own and lead the AI performance agenda across our entire platform portfolio. From identifying inefficiencies to shipping optimisation strategies, your work will directly impact the technology our users depend on in the field. You will report directly to the CEO.
The Role
This is a permanent, senior position with a company-wide remit. You will be the person Polus depends on day-to-day to keep our AI running efficiently, performing well and improving over time. As our products evolve and our use of AI grows, this role grows with it. You will have a direct line to the CEO, a seat at the table with engineering and product leadership, and the authority to set direction on how we approach AI across the business. We are looking for someone who wants to build something lasting, not just tick off a project and move on.
What You Will Do

• Own AI performance across the business. You are the person who knows where we stand, where things are improving and where we need to do better.

• Continuously monitor, test and improve how AI runs across all our platforms, treating optimisation as a permanent function rather than a one-off exercise.

• Maintain and evolve the standards, tools and benchmarks we use to measure AI performance, keeping them current as our products and models change.

• Sit at the table with product and engineering leads as a standing contributor, shaping how we build and make sure AI efficiency is considered at every stage.

• Hold long-term ownership of our AI cost and performance, making the day-to-day calls on the balance between speed, accuracy and cost as the business grows.

• Stay ahead of developments in AI models, tools and frameworks and continuously feed that knowledge back into how we operate.

• Coach and upskill engineers across teams as an ongoing responsibility, raising the bar on AI knowledge throughout the company over time.

• Build a function around AI optimisation. This role grows with the company and over time you may build a team around you.

What We Are Looking For
Essential

• Proven experience optimising large-scale AI/ML systems in production. You have shipped real improvements, not just prototypes.

• Hands-on knowledge of LLMs, transformer architectures and the trade-offs involved in deployment, including quantisation, distillation, batching, caching and RAG.

• Strong software engineering fundamentals. Python proficiency is a given and familiarity with MLOps tooling such as MLflow, Weights & Biases or Ray is expected.

• Experience with cloud AI infrastructure on AWS, GCP or Azure, and with inference serving frameworks such as vLLM, TGI or TorchServe.

• A structured, data-driven approach to problem-solving. You define metrics before you start optimising and you can make a clear business case for your work.

• Good communication skills and the confidence to influence across engineering, product and leadership without needing a formal mandate.

What Success Looks Like
In your first 90 days you will have a solid understanding of where we stand across our AI platforms, know how we will measure progress going forward, and have started shaping the way we work. Within six months you will be a core part of how engineering and product decisions get made, with real improvements showing across at least two of our core products. Within a year, the way Polus approaches AI will look different because of the work you have done. This is a role with staying power.
What We Offer

• Competitive salary and equity package.

title: Human Resources Manager
description:
Position Purpose
The Human Resources Manager runs day to day HR operations and provides practical guidance to managers and employees across RR Digital 's marketing, creative, client services, development and operations teams. The role is hands on, combining core HR execution with support for consistent people policies, sound employee relations and effective management practices. A central responsibility is training all staff and managers on HR policies and practices to reduce employment related risk.
This role supports a team of about 75 and works closely with the CEO, recruiting, Finance, and outside specialists, who provide direction on strategy and complex matters.
Reporting line: CEO.
Team responsibility: Hands on individual contributor role with no direct reports.
Responsibilities

• Own the staff HR training program. Design and deliver onboarding and recurring training on company policies, harassment and discrimination prevention, reporting concerns and nonretaliation, confidentiality, leave and accommodations, and timekeeping. Train managers on interviewing, performance documentation, corrective action and escalation. Coordinate specialized content with qualified advisers.

title: Co-Op, Characterization Electrodeposited Material
description:
Your Impact at LILA

Lila Sciences is hiring a co-op to join the Materials Science team within the Autonomous Science Platform. You will characterize electrodeposited metal films and develop the measurement methods that make those results repeatable. Deposition is handled by other scientists on the team; your focus is measurement, method development, and data quality.

The role spans electrical, surface, structural, and mechanical techniques: four-point probe for sheet resistance and resistivity, laser confocal metrology for thickness, step height, and roughness, XRD and EBSD for phase, texture, and grain structure, and hardness testing for mechanical properties. Much of the work is standing these methods up: defining sample prep, acquisition settings, and acceptance criteria so results hold across operators and sample batches.

You will work alongside scientists and engineers in a lab built for high-throughput, automated experimentation, and your protocols will feed directly into how these measurements get scaled.

What You'll Be Building

• Develop sample prep and measurement protocols for general characterization tools on electrodeposited films: four-point probe, hardness testing, and SEM/EBSD.

• Prepare samples for SEM and EBSD (mounting, polishing, surface cleanup)

• Run four-point probe, laser confocal metrology, and hardness measurements

• Analyze XRD data (phase ID, texture, peak shift, crystallite size) and EBSD data (grain size, orientation, texture)

• Validate measurement repeatability and establish data quality criteria

• Analyze and visualize characterization data, then document methods and failure modes

What You'll Need to Succeed

• Pursuing a bachelor's, master's, or PhD in Materials Science, Physics, Chemistry, Mechanical/Chemical Engineering, or a related field

• Hands-on experience operating materials characterization instruments in a lab

• Hands-on experience with hardness testing (micro- or nano-indentation, or others)

• Hands-on experience with metallographic or SEM sample prep

• Experience analyzing XRD data

• Working knowledge of thin films, metal microstructure, or surface metrology

• Careful experimental technique and detailed record keeping

• Available for the full Spring co-op term, January through May

Bonus Points For

• Master's or PhD candidates preferred

• Python for data analysis and visualization

• Experience analyzing EBSD data (e.g., MTEX, OIM, AZtec Crystal)

• Hands-on SEM and/or FIB experience

• Direct experience with four-point probe, optical profilometry, or laser confocal systems

• Familiarity with electrodeposited metals or electrochemical materials processing

• Experience developing or qualifying a new measurement method (e.g., gauge R&R)

• Exposure to automated or high-throughput laboratory workflows

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

We’re All In

title: Public Sector Partnerships - US
description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company-from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic leader to build ElevenLabs’ public sector business across the United States. The Public Sector Partnerships Manager will identify and build relationships with government institutions across the US, bridging the gap between government and our GTM team to drive adoption of ElevenLabs’ products and grow government into a strong, durable revenue stream for the company. Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies-from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups-use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Risk team builds trust, an essential ingredient for Stripe’s mission to increase the GDP of the internet. We make it possible for millions of businesses to access and use Stripe’s financial infrastructure while protecting our users, financial partners, and the broader ecosystem from harm.

Risk sits at the center of our users’ and Stripe’s ability to grow safely. We help legitimate businesses access Stripe’s financial services, provide credit to creditworthy businesses, and increasingly help users manage their own risk. We also prevent fraud and financial crime, manage Stripe’s credit exposure, meet our obligations to regulators and financial partners, and enable Stripe’s product teams to launch and grow products safely. To do this, we set the policies and standards that guide how Stripe manages risk and develop the advanced AI, infrastructure, and product experiences that put them into practice for Stripe and our users.

At Stripe’s scale-$1.9 trillion in annual payment volume, equivalent to 1.6% of global GDP, processed across millions of businesses-we face risk problems no other company has encountered. The opportunities and complexities are only growing as AI reshapes what is possible, Stripe expands its product suite, regulators raise their expectations, and we support more businesses in more countries.

What you’ll do

As a Staff Product Manager on the Risk team, you will lead cross-Risk and cross-Stripe initiatives that fundamentally change how Stripe and our users manage risk. You will identify the most important opportunities that cut across Risk’s infrastructure and products, define solutions to our most ambiguous problems, and drive execution from early technical shaping through delivery and adoption.

You will operate as a product counterpart to Risk’s senior technical leaders. You will shape infrastructure and product direction across Risk, connect work that would otherwise remain fragmented, and help product teams across Stripe build on Risk’s capabilities. You will remain deeply engaged in the work, helping teams navigate difficult technical and product decisions.

• Lead changes in Risk’s approach to using data and AI to accurately identify and mitigate risk at scale.

• Partner deeply with engineering, data science, and machine learning leaders to shape architecture, data foundations, models, APIs, and product experiences.

• Help product teams across Stripe build on Risk’s capabilities quickly and effectively while guiding Risk teams toward coherent, reusable infrastructure and product decisions.

• Build alignment among teams with different goals and constraints, resolve difficult tradeoffs, and drive progress without relying on formal authority.

Who you are

We’re looking for an exceptional product leader who combines strong technical judgment with product insight, strategic range, and executional rigor. You identify important problems before they become obvious, bring clarity to deeply ambiguous spaces, and mobilize teams around solutions that work across products, organizations, and time horizons. title: Performance & Growth Marketer
description:
Performance & Growth Marketer - eCommerce & DTC
This isn't a traditional media buying role.
We're looking for a performance marketer who understands that profitable growth goes far beyond ROAS.
You'll work with established DTC, eCommerce, Shopify and consumer brands , connecting paid media performance to the numbers that actually matter to the business: CAC, LTV, MER, contribution margin, payback, forecasting, attribution and profitability.
You'll have real ownership over performance, testing, budget allocation and growth decisions, while working closely with experienced strategists and senior stakeholders.
What You'll Do

• Own and optimize paid acquisition across Meta, Google and TikTok

• Develop and execute testing strategies across media, creative, audiences, offers and funnels

• Manage and allocate meaningful paid media budgets based on performance and commercial objectives

• Diagnose performance issues and identify opportunities for profitable growth

• Analyze CAC, LTV, MER, ROAS, contribution margin, payback and other commercial metrics

• Connect channel performance to broader business and P&L outcomes

• Develop forecasts, performance models and budget recommendations

• Contribute to attribution, incrementality and measurement initiatives

• Partner with creative, CRO and broader growth functions to improve full-funnel performance

• Turn complex data into clear, commercially relevant recommendations for founders and senior stakeholders

• Continuously test, learn and improve using structured growth frameworks

What You'll Bring

• 3+ years of hands-on paid media experience specifically with product-based DTC/eCommerce brands

• Strong hands-on experience across Meta, Google and TikTok Ads

• Experience personally managing and scaling meaningful paid media budgets

• In-house/brand-side DTC or eCommerce experience is strongly preferred

• Strong understanding of the eCommerce customer journey, from acquisition through conversion and retention

• Commercial understanding of CAC, LTV, MER, contribution margin, payback and profitability

• Ability to look beyond platform metrics and understand the impact of paid media on the overall business

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

• Ability to translate data into clear strategic and commercial recommendations

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills

• Comfortable working directly with founders, senior leaders and clients

• Highly organized, proactive and comfortable taking ownership

• Able to work full-time and exclusively

• Able to consistently work the required 4:00-6:00 PM Melbourne-time overlap

What Makes This Different
You'll be joining a team that treats performance marketing as a commercial growth function , not just a media buying function.
You'll get exposure to:

• 8- and 9-figure eCommerce and DTC brands

• Paid media, commercial strategy and financial planning

• Weekly live strategy sessions with experienced growth leaders

• A structured 6-week onboarding and development program

• Proprietary P&L-integrated reporting and growth tools

• Structured experimentation and testing frameworks

• Career progression based on impact and capability, not tenure

• A fully remote, APAC-friendly working environment

• Opportunities to develop into a broader growth and strategy role

Growth Path
Performance Marketer → Growth Performance Marketer → Senior Performance Marketer → Growth Strategist
Your level will depend on your experience, capability and demonstrated commercial impact.
We're particularly interested in marketers who have owned growth for real DTC/eCommerce brands , understand the numbers behind the business, and want to move beyond simply optimizing campaigns.
If you know how to turn paid media into profitable business growth, we'd love to hear from you.
Apply with examples of the DTC/eCommerce brands you've worked with, the channels you've managed, and the scale of budgets you've personally owned.
